description: This file defines the PendingSelfReviewSummary class, which implements the ActionSummary interface. It is part of an HR management system, specifically for generating summaries related to pending self-reviews for employees. The class constructs search filter parameters based on employee number and predefined statuses, and provides methods to retrieve group information and the count of pending self-reviews.

classes.name: PendingSelfReviewSummary
classes.description: Class managing the summary of pending self-reviews for an employee within the HRM system, constructing relevant search parameters and providing accessors for summary data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with employee-specific review search filter parameters based on predefined review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID representing the group of this summary, fixed at 4.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the string label for this group, 'Pending Self Reviews'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending self-reviews by invoking the associated service and data access objects.
